verdict.rationale: PayPal documents event delivery through webhooks: HTTPS posts on subscribed event types, up to 10 URLs per app, and retries up to 25 times over 3 days. The agent toolkit also exposes actions such as refunds, dispute acceptance, orders and shipments that a handler could call. However, there is no native way to define rules that link events to actions, so the user must build and host their own glue code. missing for 10: a first-party rule/trigger definition surface, built-in event-to-action automation without custom servers, independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven agent workflows.
